name: board.card
description: Advisory check for one Kanban card. One outcome, one next action, and the existing board at http://127.0.0.1:8913. A second board fails.

one_outcome.instructions: The card names exactly one done state.

board_is_canonical.instructions: The card is on the existing board at http://127.0.0.1:8913. It does not open a second board, list, or tracker.

next_action.instructions: How doable is the single next action on this card.
criteria: An outcome with no next action
A next action that is still vague
One next action, but no owner is named
One next action Jake can do today, and the owner is Mike

status.instructions: The next action can be done on the one canonical board. It does not open a second board, spend, or send.

rules.reason: card would open a second board
card is blocked or needs the owner

notes.bar: Pass line is above 0.9. A noul of 0.90 fails the rule `noul <= 0.90`; 0.91 or higher passes. Score and choice confidence use `confidence <= 0.90`. A score is a mean on levels 0..5, so above 0.9 of that scale is a mean above 4.50.
